description.narrative: Drylock Technologies Brasil Ltda. (Drylock or the Company) is a Brazilian-based manufacturer of private label personal hygiene products, with a portfolio ranging from baby care and feminine care to adult care. In response to growing demand, Drylock plans to expand its capacity in the country by constructing a new, state-of-the art, and eco-friendly plant in the broader São Paulo region (the Project). The Project will feature the latest clean technology, delivering high-quality products at lower costs to the Brazilian market.

The most significant expected project-level outcomes include increased purchases from domestic suppliers including SMEs and economy-wide GDP and job creation. Beyond the project-level impact, IFC expects the Project to enhance the competitiveness of Brazils baby and adult care products sector by increasing the availability of high-quality and cost-effective private labels.
